title: 8.1.8 Lab: Read the Script
description: Switch to Code, find the number that controls the hole, and change it. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Switch to Code
steps.instructions: You're starting from a 40 x 40 x 20 mm box with a 6 mm hole through it, already built. Press the Code tab at the top left to see it written out as text.
hints: Code and Build are the two tabs in the top-left corner, next to each other.
You should see two lines: one starting with const box1 = box(...), and one starting with hole(box1, ...).

steps.title: Find the hole's number and change it
steps.instructions: On the hole(box1, { across: 6 }) line, change the 6 to a 10. Leave everything else on that line exactly as it is.
hints: The number is inside the curly braces, right after across:.
Don't add or remove any punctuation — just replace the digit 6 with 10.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: Press Run. Switch back to Build and check the hole in the 3D view — it should look noticeably wider than before.
hints: If nothing changed, make sure you pressed Run after editing the text.

requirements.title: A 10 mm hole through the box
requirements.description: The box has a hole 10 mm across, drilled through the top face.
requirements.hint: In Code, change the 6 in hole(box1, { across: 6 }) to 10, then press Run.
